name: basic_prune_branches
assertions: identifies branches that have been merged or deleted on remote
runs in dry-run mode by default (no deletions without confirmation)
lists stale branches that would be removed
does NOT delete any branches without explicit confirmation

name: clean_up_old_branches
assertions: recognizes 'clean up old branches' as a prune intent
fetches remote refs to detect stale tracking branches
identifies local branches whose upstream has been deleted
presents the list of candidates for deletion before acting

name: dry_run_default
assertions: defaults to dry-run mode without --force flag
lists all branches that would be pruned
does NOT actually delete any branches
displays the count of stale branches found
shows how to re-run with --force to apply deletions

name: force_flag_with_confirmation
assertions: recognizes the --force flag to perform actual deletions
prompts for final confirmation before deleting branches
deletes only the identified stale branches
reports which branches were successfully deleted

name: protected_branches_never_deleted
input: prune all stale branches including everything
assertions: never deletes main or master branches
never deletes the currently checked-out branch
excludes protected branches from the prune candidate list
explicitly states which branches are protected and skipped

name: negative_docker_prune
assertions: does NOT trigger the prune skill
recognizes 'docker prune' as a Docker operation, not git
does NOT attempt to delete any git branches

name: no_stale_branches_found
assertions: fetches remote refs to check for stale branches
detects that no branches are stale
reports that no branches need pruning
exits cleanly without errors or deletions

name: prune_after_pr_merge
input: clean up branches from merged PRs
assertions: identifies branches whose PRs have been merged
cross-references local branches with remote merge status
lists merged-PR branches as prune candidates
runs in dry-run mode by default
